findings: 2026-11-05: drafted for Mathematics 11 Unit 11 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.

Book correction: As in 11.1.1, the line of excluded angles is printed jumbled in the book (\frac{3\pi}{2} and \frac{5\pi}{2} overlap). It should read \theta \ne \pm\frac{\pi}{2}, \pm\frac{3\pi}{2}, \pm\frac{5\pi}{2}, \ldots

Book correction: The book writes 0 \le x \le 1 and -1 \le x \le 0, but x = 0 is not allowed (\frac{1}{0} has no value; we have just excluded it). The correct statements are: 0 < x \le 1 \Rightarrow \frac{1}{x} \ge 1 -1 \le x < 0 \Rightarrow \frac{1}{x} \le -1 The conclusion (the range) is not affected.
